actions.expr:
IIF(CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[NA]'),
NUMBER(width),
IIF(
CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[Rect-Both Sides]','$[Rect-One Side]'),
(NUMBER(width)+(2*CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Conversion Inch to mm]','cost')))),
IIF(CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[Round-Both Sides]','$[Round-One Side]'),
(NUMBER(diameterDi)+(2*CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Conversion Inch to mm]','cost')))),0)
)
)

IIF(CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[NA]'),
NUMBER(height),
IIF(
CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[Rect-Both Sides]','$[Rect-One Side]'),
(NUMBER(height)+(2*CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Conversion Inch to mm]','cost')))),
IIF(CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[Round-Both Sides]','$[Round-One Side]'),
(NUMBER(diameterDi)+(2*CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Conversion Inch to mm]','cost')))),0)
)
)

IIF(
    CONTAINS(
        subcategory,
        '$[Control Dampers-Flanged Frame]',
        '$[Control Dampers-Fire Rated]',
        '$[Control Dampers-NRD-PRD]'
    ),
    ((NUMBER(heightX) - 4) / 1000) * (159 / 1000),
    0
)

CFLOAT( IIF( ((SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType) == '3V') && (COUNT(subcategory) > 0)), OBJECTATTRIBUTEF(bladeDetails,CONCAT( IIF( TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD100F', 'cd100_f', IIF( TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD125H', 'cd125_h', IIF( TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD175S', 'cd175_s', IIF( ((TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CDW') || (TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='FRCDW')), 'cdw', 'cd165_f' ) ) ) ), '_3_v_4_inch')), 0 ) )

CFLOAT( IIF( ((COUNT(bladeType) > 0) && (COUNT(subcategory) > 0)), OBJECTATTRIBUTEF(bladeDetails, EVALUATE('return input.arg1.toLowerCase();', CONCAT( IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD100F','cd100_f', IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD125H','cd125_h', IIF(((TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CDW') || (TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='FRCDW')),'cdw', IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD175S','cd175_s','cd165_f'))) ), '_',IIF(SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType)=='3V','3_v',SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType)),'_5_inch')) ) , 0 ) )

CFLOAT( IIF( ((COUNT(bladeType) > 0) && (COUNT(subcategory) > 0)), OBJECTATTRIBUTEF(bladeDetails, EVALUATE('return input.arg1.toLowerCase();', CONCAT( IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD100F','cd100_f', IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD125H','cd125_h', IIF(((TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CDW') || (TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='FRCDW')),'cdw', IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD175S','cd175_s','cd165_f'))) ), '_',IIF(SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType)=='3V','3_v',SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType)),'_6_inch')) ) , 0 ) )

CFLOAT( IIF( ((COUNT(bladeType) > 0) && (COUNT(subcategory) > 0)), OBJECTATTRIBUTEF(bladeDetails, EVALUATE('return input.arg1.toLowerCase();', CONCAT( IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD100F','cd100_f', IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD125H','cd125_h', IIF(((TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CDW') || (TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='FRCDW')),'cdw', IIF(TEXT(subCategoryCode)=='CD175S','cd175_s','cd165_f'))) ), '_',IIF(SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType)=='3V','3_v',SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType)),'_7_inch')) ) , 0 ) )

NUMBER(smallSpindle)*
IIF(SELECTEDVALUE(bladeAxleType)=='Round',
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Small Spindle-Round Bush 12mm GI Round Shaft]','cost')),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI 10mm Square Pin]','cost'))
)

NUMBER(bigSpindle)*IIF(SELECTEDVALUE(bladeAxleType)=='Round',
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Big Spindle-Round Bush 12mm GI Round Shaft]','cost')),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Big Spindle-Round BushGI Blade Shaft Square 9.50x9.50x120mm]','cost'))
)

( (NUMBER(noOfBladesPerSection) * IIF(
(SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType)=='3V'),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[3V Fixed Blade Minutes per Blade (VCDA)]','cost')),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AF Fixed Blade Minutes per Blade (VCDA)]','cost'))
) )
 + 
((NUMBER(widthY) / 1000)*NUMBER(noOfBladesPerSection) *
IIF(
(SELECTEDVALUE(bladeType)=='3V'),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[3V Variable Blade Minutes per Blade (VCDA)]','cost')),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AF Variable Blade Minutes per Blade (VCDA)]','cost'))
)
) ) *NUMBER(noofSections)

IIF(
    SELECTEDVALUE(externalSleeve) == 'Yes',

((CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Fixed Sleeve Minutes (VCDA)]','cost'))
*
IIF((NUMBER(noofSections)<4),1,IIF((NUMBER(noofSections)<8),2,3))
)
+ 
( NUMBER(sleeveArea) * CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Variable Sleeve Minutes (VCDA)]','cost')) ) ),
0 )

CONCAT(

    IIF((NUMBER(width) > 0), CONCAT('W:', NUMBER(width)), ''),

    IIF((NUMBER(height) > 0), CONCAT(' H:', NUMBER(height)), ''),

    IIF((NUMBER(diameterDi) > 0), CONCAT(' D:', NUMBER(diameterDi)), ''),

    IIF(
        (NUMBER(sleeveLength) > 0) && CONTAINS(externalSleeve,'$[Yes]'),
        CONCAT(' L:', NUMBER(sleeveLength)),
        IIF(
            (COUNT(baseModel) > 0) && (CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEF(baseModel,'frame_width')) > 0),
            CONCAT(' L:', OBJECTATTRIBUTEF(baseModel,'frame_width')),
            ''
        )
    ),

    IIF(
        (COUNT(frameMaterialType) > 0),
        CONCAT(' - ', SELECTEDVALUE(frameMaterialType)),
        ''
    ),

    ' ',

    SELECTEDVALUE(baseModel),

    IIF(
        CONTAINS(damperOperator, '$[Motorized]'),
        ' Motorized',
        ''
    ),

    IIF(
        CONTAINS(fireRated, '$[Fire Rated]'),
        ' Fire Rated',
        ''
    ),

    EVALUATE(
    '
    var str = input.arg1;

    if(str.indexOf("Pressure") != -1) return " PRD";
    if(str.indexOf("Backdraft") != -1) return " BDD";
    if(str.indexOf("Return") != -1) return " NRD";

    return " VCD";
    ',
    SELECTEDVALUE(modelName)
    )
)

IIF(
    (NUMBER(noofSections)<=1),0, 
    (((((NUMBER(noOfWidthSections)) - 1) * NUMBER(height)) + 
    (((NUMBER(noOfHeightSections)) - 1) * NUMBER(width)) )
/1000*2*CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Joints Minutes for Multi-Section per m (VCDA)]','cost'))) 
+ (CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Fixed Joints Minutes per Section (VCDA)]','cost')) * (NUMBER(noofSections) - 1)) )

IIF(
    CONTAINS(subcategory, '$[Control Dampers-Welded Frame]','$[Control Dampers-Welded Fire Rated]'),
    (
        IIF(
            (SELECTEDVALUE(frameMaterialType) == 'AL' ),
            CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Welding Cost (VCDA)]','cost')),
            IIF(
                ((SELECTEDVALUE(frameMaterialType) == 'SS304L') || (SELECTEDVALUE(frameMaterialType) == 'SS316L')),

            ((NUMBER(frameSlitSize)/1000*4*NUMBER(noofSections)) + NUMBER(angleLength)),

            CONTAINS(bendType, '$[Self Bend]'),
            (NUMBER(frameSlitSize) - (2*CFLOAT(SELECTEDVALUE(smfAngleSize)))/1000*4*NUMBER(noofSections)),

    ),
0

((NUMBER(totalMaterialCostBeforeMotors)+NUMBER(totalAssemblyCost)+ NUMBER(fireRatedCost)+NUMBER(weldingCost)) 
* 
(IIF(((NUMBER(heightX) > 500) || (NUMBER(widthY) > 500)),
